prompt:
Create NEW ORIGINAL Ashveil Cinder Bear WALKING pixel-art drawings using the two attached OWN game sheets for the EXACT individual model: a 340kg low broad quadruped bear, immense shoulder hump and heavy rump, short thick neck and broad SHORT bear muzzle kept below shoulder line, tiny rounded ears, tiny stub tail, charcoal-tipped ash-grey upper fur over dark brown fur. Keep its bulk, head size, fur pattern, neck height and body dimensions CONSTANT between four key poses. Exactly TWO FORELEGS and TWO HINDLEGS, each attached to the correct shoulder or hip, broad clawed paws. No wolf/dog/dinosaur proportions, no elongated neck, no large pointed ears, no human hands, no weapon/equipment, no upright pose. Crisp richly detailed square pixel-art clusters, canonical elevated three-quarter game camera. This is a slow four-beat BEAR WALK with only ONE paw in a short recovery swing at a time; the other THREE paws clearly support its weight. It is NOT a trot, gallop, jump, swipe, standing idle or four repeated poses. New body and limb pixels, not a transformed/mirrored reference crop. Build a 2 by 2 atlas with FOUR whole-body sprites in reading order upper-left F0, upper-right F1, lower-left F2, lower-right F3. Each sprite occupies only middle 65 percent of its cell with at least 12 percent transparent gutters around the entire fur/paws/tail. Transparent alpha PNG, no floor/shadow/backdrop/checkerboard/text/grid. Target1280x1280. Keep all four legs/paws countable by small natural near/far separation below belly; far legs darker but still readable. Paw in air has clear gap above virtual ground, supporting paws flat planted. Do not draw extra limbs to illustrate motion.
FOUR CHRONOLOGICAL FOUR-BEAT PHASES, absolute anatomical labels: F0 LEFT HIND paw lifts and swings forward under hip; left front planted forward, right hind planted back, right front supports under shoulder. F1 LEFT FRONT paw lifts and swings forward under chest; left hind has now landed ahead under hip, right front and right hind planted. F2 RIGHT HIND paw lifts and swings forward; right front planted forward, left hind planted back, left front supports under shoulder. F3 RIGHT FRONT paw lifts and swings forward under chest; right hind now landed ahead under hip, left front and left hind planted. F0 vs F2 and F1 vs F3 MUST exchange the actual anatomical left/right swinging limbs, not redraw the same nearest raised paw. Stable low neck and tiny vertical trunk bob; feel heavy weight transferring onto planted limbs.
All FOUR drawings face LEFT, nose at left and rump right. The bear's anatomical LEFT flank/left legs are NEAR the viewer, RIGHT flank/right legs are FAR. Therefore F0 raises NEAR HIND paw, F1 raises NEAR FRONT paw, F2 raises FAR HIND paw while NEAR HIND is flat on ground, F3 raises FAR FRONT paw while NEAR FRONT is flat on ground. Critical: bottom-right must lift the FAR forepaw, not repeat the lifted NEAR forepaw of upper-right. Do not change to front view.
